follow-up time: From 18th-22nd week of gestation to 28th-32nd week of gestation
cohort: 63 patients with long-term pregestational type 1 diabetes (PGDM).
finding: Pregnant women with PGDM who developed preeclampsia had significantly higher mid-gestation corin levels, urine protein loss in each trimester, serum creatinine in the third trimester, and lower creatinine clearance in the third trimester.
